item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera holds a bar magnet a few centimetres above some iron pins on her study table at home. The pins jump up and stick to the magnet, even though the magnet never touches them.
Which statement correctly describes the force acting on the pins?

options.A: The magnet pulls the pins only after touching them, so the force acts with contact.
options.B: The magnet exerts a magnetic force on the iron pins, and this force acts without contact.
options.C: The pins rise because air pushes them up, so no force from the magnet is involved.
options.D: The magnet can only attract objects that are already magnets, so the pins must be magnets first.
